success_clauses.requirement: Record a complete 3D spin-glass Hamiltonian and disorder distribution.
Pass exact or reliable literature benchmarks at small sizes.
Demonstrate PT equilibration with round trips and autocorrelation evidence.
Show an MPS neural VMCRG improvement on at least one preregistered metric over a fair finite-coupling baseline.
Actually complete and equilibrate L=45 production data.
Obtain compatible Tc intervals from xi_L/L and Binder evidence.
Obtain an RG-flow Tc interval statistically compatible with FSS.
Cover multiple independent algorithm seeds and enough unique J samples.
Report statistical, finite-size, neural, and non-equilibration uncertainty.
Report negative results, failed convergence, and initialization dependence without replacing seeds or moving thresholds.
